name: reopen_text_window

stack.evidence: func_001CDB18 consumes one window ID and starts the alternate text-window activation chain func_001CDA00/func_001CD8E8

notes: The handler reuses the same D_00623C30 window template and four-slot text-window state used by command 0 open_text_window, but its alternate worker waits on the existing per-window worker at D_003854E0+0x1010 rather than starting the normal func_001CCB18 open path. Corpus placement distinguishes it as the reuse path: command 0 is followed by set_text_window_text in all 874 calls and overwhelmingly follows initial window setup, while this command commonly follows close or prior text-window commands. Of 191 JP calls, 182 are followed by command 1 set_text_window_text.
